author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

#### PR description:

`RefCoreStreamerGuard` reset the thread's product getter to `nullptr` when destroyed, instead of restoring the previous one. If two guards end up nesting on the same thread, the inner one clears the getter of the outer one.

Restore the previous getter instead.

Add a unit test for nested guards.

#### PR validation:

All unit tests pass.
title: Restore the previous product getter in `RefCoreStreamerGuard`
